semantic_limits: LilyPond language table supports the B/H pitch distinctions. Its English flat syntax is bf/b-flat; the authored Bb token is a declared canonical English spelling and is not claimed to be runnable LilyPond syntax.
MusicXML chromatic and octave-change offsets add once in the ordinary non-doubled fixtures. Clef octave metadata describes a transposing clef and is not blindly added as a second sounding offset.

The unchanged parser loses transpose and clef-octave metadata; integer parsing loses decimal alter 0.5. Invalid H/missing-octave pitches become None while a duration/type-valid note remains. These are pinned-source fixture observations, not schema conformance or live-service conclusions.
Capo pitch-class arithmetic preserves major/minor interval quality; capo 12 preserves pitch class and raises absolute pitch by 12 semitones.
